A made-up agent for Conductor's tests, its help in the form clap prints

Usage: helper [OPTIONS] [PROMPT]
       helper [OPTIONS] <COMMAND> [ARGS]

Commands:
  exec  Runs once and ends
  help  Prints the help of a command

Arguments:
  [PROMPT]
          What to begin with

Options:
  -c, --config <key=value>
          Changes one setting for this run. The value is read as TOML (`a.b.c`).

          Examples: - `-c model="x"` - `-c name=y`

      --enable <FEATURE>
          Turns a feature on (repeatable)

  -m, --model <MODEL>
          The model the agent uses

      --local-provider <PROVIDER>
          Which local provider to use (first or second). Without it the
          setting decides

  -s, --sandbox <SANDBOX_MODE>
          How the commands it runs are fenced in

          [possible values: read-only, workspace-write, danger-full-access]

      --approve-for-me
          Sends the questions to an automatic review

      --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox
          Asks nothing and fences nothing

      --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust
          Runs hooks without asking whether they are trusted

  -C, --cd <DIR>
          The folder to work in

      --add-dir <DIR>
          Another folder the agent may write in

  -a, --ask-for-approval <APPROVAL_POLICY>
          When to ask before a command runs

          Possible values:
          - on-request: The model asks when it wants
            to
          - never:      Never asks

  -i, --image <FILE>...
          Pictures to attach to the first prompt

  -h, --help
          Prints help

  -V, --version
          Prints the version
